from LJ:

Once I was riding on the neighboring bunk with a sailor. A real sailor, only a miner. That is, he's generally a sailor, because he sailed the seas for a hell of a lot of years. I don't remember as what, a boatswain or someone else, but the main thing is that he's a sailor. Which means he can spin sea tales until the sea devil whistles on the mountain. That is, all the time he's not sleeping. I boarded the train at 6 AM, naturally after a night of packing I surrendered without a fight to the "chook-chook", and at 11 I learned that across from me rides a sailor. Because at 11 he woke up and opened his mouth, and closed it only at 23, and only because they closed it for him under the pretext "everyone's asleep already, enough chatter". And all that time he was spinning tales. Sea tales. Over several years of sailing he'd accumulated far more of them than 12 hours. It's like riding in one compartment with Jack Sparrow. And when suitable sea tales stopped coming to mind, he remembered that he's actually a miner now, and started telling miner tales. Because he somehow got tired of sailing the seas and decided to go underground. For variety. Why be petty - from water straight underground. There was actually a reasonable explanation for this, but I can't remember it now. But the point is that he's a sailor, but now a miner, and can tell about the life of a miner. As if the sea one wasn't enough for us.

I still have one tube monitor standing. Moreover. It's not just tube, but also glitchy.
